sentences.text: 5. Report regarding the stage of trial, earlier called for, has been received.
It appears that charge has been framed in this case on 11.11.2024 but the prosecution has not produced any witness.
5. It was submitted that the petitioner is in custody since 24.06.2024.
6. Considering the period of custody and the fact that trial has not progressed yet, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Sri Satish Kumar Munda, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Godda or his successor in connection with Lalmatiya P.S. Case No. 41/2024 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 671/2024.
